Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used TMT16plex labeling combined with TiO2-based phosphopeptide enrichment and DDA acquisition on an Orbitrap Lumos.

scope: Parental wild type TeloHAECs were plated on 500 ng/mL of FN and let to adhere in presence or not of 200 ng/mL of human VEGF-B 167 (751-VE, R&D System) for 15 or 30 min, in poor medium. Cells were lysed in Chromatin H20, 2.5% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), 250 mM Tris-HCl, pH 6.8, at 95°C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The MS analysis was performed on whole cell lysates of TeloHAECs. While phosphorylated peptides were enriched using TiO2 beads, this is a post-lysis peptide-level enrichment and does not constitute a subcellular fractionation of the starting material.
